note: RISK-ONLY ASSESSMENT. Sanctions: no hit. OFAC Sanctions List Search tool was reachable but is a JavaScript form that cannot be queried via plain HTTP GET, and the bulk SDN CSV/XML downloads returned only truncated header rows, so a direct OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS name-by-name confirmation could NOT be completed — sanctions_hit=false is therefore based on OpenSanctions aggregation, not on a primary-list lookup. Recommend a manual primary-list screen before contracting. All are ordinary commercial/tax disputes; none is a criminal matter against the company or its owners. Per project rule 2, none of these is a rejection ground and they are recorded neutrally: 'есть сложности'.
